changes.text: 结局也可以交代一笔。胡适自述，运动约四年就在学校教育上基本成功：1920年北京政府教育部通令，国民小学一、二年级教材一律改用白话，旧教材分期废除。他说这场斗争“至少获得了部分的胜利”，其中重要的部分是以白话为教育工具；他同时说，1919年的学生运动把文化运动变成了政治运动，对文艺复兴运动是一种“干扰”，虽则对传播白话文功不可没。

The outcome can be set down too. By Hu's account, in only about four years the effort to replace the classical language with the vernacular in the schools had all but succeeded: in 1920 the Ministry of Education of the Beijing government ordered that all first- and second-year textbooks in the national primary schools be written entirely in the vernacular, with the old textbooks abolished in stages. He said the struggle had won at least a partial victory, the important part being the vernacular as the instrument of education. He also said the student movement of 1919 had been an interruption to the Renaissance movement, turning a cultural movement into a political one, though it did much to spread the vernacular.

dispositions.rationale: 胡适原话“至少获得了部分的胜利”是保底式肯定。原稿中文的“但他称之为”构成转折，英文的“Yet … only a partial victory”把“至少”译成了“只”，方向与原文相反。现在删去“但”“Yet”“only”。中文改为直接转述其原话“至少获得了部分的胜利”，英文相应改为 at least a partial victory，中英一致。其余句子未改动。

evidence.quote: 因此在我们的斗争中，至少获得了部分的胜利。其中重要的部分就是以白话文为教育的工具。
